title: Repeated FP32 contraction rewrites can produce explicit guarded MMA candidates
observation: GEMM and GEMM+SiLU manually replace row-wise full-B broadcast multiply and K sum with tiled IEEE FP32 MMA and a pointwise epilogue. Search candidates and final confirmations pass all five original oracle cases. The GEMM raw 51-row counter file records SQ_INSTS_MMOP=8192, arch_vgpr=48 and lds=16384 per CTA. The retained ISA has 32 static v_mmac_16x16x8_f32 instructions, with four K iterations and 64 CTAs. Some author journal text incorrectly says zero LDS; the raw file and profile report take precedence. Diagnostic callable samples are not independent Bench speedups. Existing IR/lowering already expresses the mechanism; the missing reusable artifact is a complete guarded rewrite, not a new MMA primitive.
proposed_change: Expose specialize_fp32_contraction through Compiler and the existing Program transformation registry. Match ordinary direct FP32 A[M,K] and B[K,N] or B[N,K] loads, broadcast multiply and one CTA sum. Preserve the compatible pointwise epilogue, global ABI and workload metadata. Callers explicitly select row/column/K tiles, execution groups and stages. Reject unrelated graph, storage and effect commitments; use IEEE FP32 only and retain external-oracle numerical acceptance.
design_review: P1: existing Schedule/Program calls. P2: caller-selected tiles, groups and stages remain explicit. P3: one candidate constructor over existing load/transpose/MMA/elementwise forms. P4: input and result assessment plus lowering. P5: existing access maps and K carry expose ownership. P6: focused counterexamples and unchanged Corpus Gate. P7: no new primitive or analysis exception. P8: gfx938 source evidence bounds applicability; compiled resources and performance still require target validation.
promotion_disposition: Explicit candidate construction is implemented and independently reviewed. Three pass-generated gfx938 candidates pass all original cases and have same-direction ordinary-call improvements in both paired orders. This validates the bounded mechanism and public API, not a universal tile/stage policy, global numerical guarantee, community Bench result or fresh-author search effect. The gemm_bias numerical counterexample remains failed and unmeasured. The source PR remains under integration review.

verified_by.protocol: All five original cases in both arms, original oracle after release; then 10 warmups per arm, 60 alternating AB/BA pairs and 30 A/A pairs on primary, ordinary allocation-returning calls with synchronize. No graph, trimming or retry.
verified_by.runtime: gfx938, wave64, DTK Triton 3.6.0; real JIT cache, executed HSACO and launch metadata matched the CPU-staged specialization. HCU1 admission and all corresponding releases passed. Physical exclusivity is not established.
verified_by.scope: Development starter comparison, not an independent community Bench or a fresh-author agent-efficiency study.
verified_by.correctness: 15/15 original cases pass in each arm; inputs preserved.
verified_by.software: At d7a0fe43: focused50 contracts/210subtests; author+Program50 contracts/11subtests; Corpus204/204. PR #465 Python3.10/3.11/3.12 contracts and baseline/successor offline Triton jobs passed. Independent source and device-evidence reviews found no blocker.

numerical_counterexample.result: Both starter and pass-generated candidate fail mixed_magnitude with27 mismatches each; other four cases pass. Timing is forbidden and absent. This is not attributed uniquely to the new pass.
